identity.title: Is this you, {name}?
identity.lead: This number’s account hasn’t been used for 6 months. Numbers sometimes pass to someone new, so we ask before you go in.
identity.ownsWorkspace: This account owns a business on {brand}, so it can’t start afresh here. Contact {brand} to sort out the number.

name.title: What’s your name?
name.lead: Your number is verified. Enter your name for your {brand} account — your team will see you by this name.

invite.admin3: You can change services, prices and settings
invite.specialist1: You’ll see your own calendar and bookings
invite.specialist2: You can answer your own requests
invite.specialist3: You’ll see your own clients and earnings
invite.declineLead: {name} will be told. To join later you’ll need a new invite.

expired.title: The invite has expired
expired.lead: Each invite works for {days} days. The invite {business} sent on {sent} ended on {ended}.
expired.note: Ask the owner to send it again — the new invite will appear here.

empty.title: You don’t have a workspace yet
empty.lead: Open your business: calendar, online booking and a client list — free.
empty.note: Work at a business? Ask the owner to send an invite to your phone number — it will appear here.

opening.title: Opening {business}…
opening.one: We open the workspace you used last.
opening.many: You have {count} workspaces. We open the one you used last; pick another at the top of the left menu.

setup.title: Continue setting up {business}
setup.lead: You stopped at {step, select, business {your business details} address {your address} hours {your hours} services {your services} team {your team} rules {your booking rules} other {the last step}}. Everything you entered so far is saved.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The address may have a typo, or the page has moved.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.lead: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

hours.sameHint: Pick the time once for Monday–Friday

setup.title: Set up your business
setup.caption: 8 steps · about 5 minutes · free

phone.title: Welcome to {app}
phone.leadSms: Enter your phone number — we’ll send you a 4-digit code. No password needed.
phone.nameHint: For your {brand} account — your team will see you by this name. You’ll be the owner of the business.

business.title: About your business
business.lead: Clients find you by this name and category. The category also suggests starter services.

business.name: Business name
business.nameLong: Too long: up to {max, number} characters.

address.title: Where will clients find you?

address.tooLong: Too long: up to {max, number} characters.

hours.title: Your hours
hours.lead: Clients can book only within these hours. You’ll add staff shifts later.
hours.hintNoDay: At least one day must be open.

services.lead: Pick from the ready list, then adjust each name, duration and price to suit you.

team.title: Who do you work with?
team.lead: With a team, each specialist gets their own calendar and clients can pick who they book with.
team.teamCaption: Each specialist gets their own calendar
team.soloNote: Clients won’t pick a specialist — every booking comes to you. You can invite people later in Settings → Team.
team.name: Name

team.notMobile: Mobile numbers only — enter a number starting with {starts}.
team.taken: This number is already on the team.
team.invited: They’ll see the invite when they sign in with {phone} · valid 7 days

rules.title: How should bookings arrive?
rules.lead: Confirm each new online booking yourself, or accept it at once.
rules.manualCaption: Every new booking arrives as a request
rules.instantCaption: The client is booked as soon as they pick a free time
rules.holdHint: If no one answers in this time, the request is cancelled and the client is offered other times. The time counts only while you’re open. The hold never runs past the visit’s start.
rules.whoHint: You have a team — who can confirm or decline online requests. You can always answer.
rules.whoNote: Requests for specialists who don’t use the app always go to you and the admins.
rules.instantNote: The client sees “Booking confirmed” at once. Block the times you’re busy in the calendar.
rules.cancelHint: Later than this, a client can only cancel by calling you.
rules.bufferHint: Free time kept after each service to get ready for the next client.
rules.settingsLater: You can change all of this later in Settings.

done.title: {name} is ready!
done.lead: Add bookings that come by phone or walk-in. Online booking opens after the review.
done.inReview: Your page is in review — only you and your team can see it. After the review it opens in search and at your link. You can use the calendar now.

done.previewLabel: After the review, clients see you like this
done.linkReady: Your link and QR code are ready — they open to clients after the review.
done.qrNote: Print it and put it by the till: after the review clients scan it with their phone and book straight away.

quality.title: Make your page stronger
quality.logoCaption: Shown next to your name in search and on your page
quality.photosCaption: The first photo is your card’s picture in search
quality.aboutCaption: Tell clients what to expect: services, products, experience

bookingRules.instantCaption: The client’s booking is confirmed at once. You just get a notification.

bookingRules.cancelHint: Later than this, a client can only cancel by calling you.
